text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shortly before the Hopeful Stakes. Ahead 
of Mejiro Bright's race, glad tidings 
arrived for the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober! Mejiro Dober claims a 
brilliant victory in a Junior Class GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A massive upset against the heavy 
favorite, Seeking the Pearl! And now, that 
dream is passed on to Mejiro Bright!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! That was a splendid run. You're 
not half bad, are you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Trainer-sama. Following 
Dober's lead, let's do our best~. Hip hip 
hooray~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A "hip, hip, hooray"...? You're awfully 
calm considering a GⅠ is right around the 
corner. Meanwhile, I was so stiff with 
nerves...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, um... are you okay? Honestly, you 
should probably tighten it a bit more...
choice_data_list: Well, isn't it fine the way it is?
Well, isn't it fine the way it is?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh, did Bright's laid-back vibe rub off 
on you? Are both of you really okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure it will be just fine~ Right, 
Trainer?"
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, just stay calm when you run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through all that we've built up, I've 
gradually come to believe. In Mejiro 
Bright's "late-race kick."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it looks a bit risky, she always 
makes her flying charge in the end. Surely 
this time will be no different."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Thank you for believing in me, Trainer. 
...It reminds me of the old days.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Back when I was still young... I remember 
the time that person encouraged me.)

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-What's wrong, Bright? Why do you have 
such a troubled look on your face?

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
They told me so~. They said an Umamusume 
like you could never run fast~...

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's why I tried to run in a hurry~. And 
then, BAM, I fell flat on my face~...

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, I see. Don't worry about it, 
Bright.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Who's to say she'll never run fast? She's 
not even grown up yet—there's no way 
anyone could know for sure.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Your journey is only just beginning. 
...All of yours. Bright's and Dober's, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You can prove them wrong little by little. 
So don't give up, okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: Ryan... dearest sister...

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright, show me where you fell and hit 
yourself earlier. Are you sure you didn't 
hurt it?

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: Where I bumped it...? ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, she's totally fine. Incredible, she 
doesn't have a single scratch...

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that Bright... has super 
strong bones? Like, totally packed with 
calcium!

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: The bone? Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, definitely. Just like me! If that's 
the case, we can train as much as we want.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"So there's nothing to worry about. The 
future is definitely bright, so let's just 
go at our own pace."

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright has her own way of running. Right?

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: Sister Ryan...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Ryan-oneesama, I've finally found them~. 
Someone who believes in me, and waits for 
me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(I dedicate today's run to you~. To 
Trainer-sama, and to Ryan-oneesama on that 
day~)
